source_documents.title: A novel camphor-based fluorescent probe for sensing thiophenols in food analysis and biological imaging via a PET-TICT integrated mechanism

reference_evidence_units.quote: integrated mechanism was proposed to illustrate this unique phenomenon, in which the DNP play the role of a-PET-blocking and rotation-restricting group to keep the fluorescence
reference_evidence_units.subject: CQXPN
reference_evidence_units.statement: In the probe the dinitrophenyl ethers block a-PET and restrict rotation, so it is fluorescent.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The molecule containing DNP moiety (CQXPN) dis played a strong fluorescence intensity, while molecule cleaving DNB moiety (CQXP) exhibited almost no fluorescence (Scheme 1 b).
reference_evidence_units.subject: CQXPN vs CQXP
reference_evidence_units.statement: The probe is bright; the bis-phenol is nearly dark.

reference_evidence_units.quote: When the DNP group was removed by thiophenols, the hy droxyl group in CQXP activated the a-PET process with the phenol groups under unbound and free rotating conditions (the TICT state)
reference_evidence_units.subject: CQXP
reference_evidence_units.statement: The free phenols drive a-PET and rotate freely into a TICT state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: As shown in Fig. 6a and Figs. S10–S13, the initial fluorescence intensities of CQXB in different solvents were much higher than CQXP, indicating the existence of a-PET in CQXP [61].
reference_evidence_units.subject: CQXB vs CQXP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Removing the OH (phenyl model) restores emission: evidence for a-PET in CQXP.

reference_evidence_units.quote: With the increase of solvents’ polarity, the fluorescence intensity of CQXPN, CQXB and CQXJ decreased only 11.7, 3.6 and 4.8 folds respectively, while CQXP decreased 82.1 folds (Fig. 6b and S10-S11).
reference_evidence_units.subject: CQXP, CQXPN, CQXB, CQXJ
reference_evidence_units.statement: Only CQXP is strongly quenched by polarity (TICT signature).

reference_evidence_units.quote: In our initial design, the fluorophore CQXP was a donor-acceptordonor (D-A-D) type molecule with extended conjugation where camphor fused thiadiazolo-phenazine acted as the acceptor and phenol units acted as the donors (Scheme 1b).
reference_evidence_units.subject: CQXP

contrast_group.varied_factor: para substituent of the aryl wings (OH vs H vs O-2,4-dinitrophenyl)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Free phenols (CQXP) are nearly dark through a-PET and TICT; the phenyl model and the DNP ether are bright and much less polarity-sensitive.
